content:
sam: Heads up — started seeing short reconnect storms in us-east after the proxy v2 rollout. Client resumes look idempotent but we get repeated reconnects and the console shows fewer events than billing. Logs attached.
ingrid: Saw this too. Proxy seems to pause for ~100-300ms on chunk boundaries. Clients treat that as EOF and reconnect. Telemetry sampling then suppresses duplicates.
devon: can you paste a tiny log snippet?
sam: ```
[stream] session=abc123 event=chunk_recv latency=180ms chunk_end=true
[stream] session=abc123 event=keepalive_missed count=1
[stream] session=abc123 event=reconnect reason=client_eof
```
kevin: :thinking_face: Is telemetry coalescing them? Console shows 1 recon per session but billing shows multiple token charges.
maria: Yeah, our sampling rule dedups reconnects within 10s, so console undercounts proxy-induced flaps. Billing uses raw resume events and is charged. We need a way to mark cause so we can dedup in billing pipeline when it's a known proxy pause.
devon: Proposal: have the proxy inject a header on 204/resume or on any pause path like `X-Reconnect-Cause: proxy_pause` and `X-Reconnect-TTL: 800`. Metrics pipeline can pick that up. Minimal change.
sam: The proxy already sets `X-Proxy-Signal: pause` internally but it doesn't flow through to resume responses. Mapping would be small.
ingrid: Alternative is client heuristic: treat short pauses <400ms as stream-linger and avoid hard EOF. Risk is delaying detection for true disconnects.
kevin: Tradeoffs: delaying detection hurts tail failure detection & may mask real disconnects. I prefer annotation + telemetry fix + conservative client canary.
maria: Plan: 1) inject `X-Reconnect-Cause` header from proxy -> metrics 2) canary client linger change to 400ms on 5% traffic 3) dashboard tile showing reconnects by cause 4) console rollout toggle for the canary UX change with clear explanation.
devon: I'll open the proxy PR to map header -> response + add tests. Also add TTL header so the metric pipeline knows how long to dedup.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary deploy started for proxy v2 on us-east-1 (5% traffic).
sam: I'll spin up a quick adhoc dashboard to compare recon counts (raw) vs cause-tagged for before/after. Query: count(reconnects) by reconnect.cause over 5m.
maria: I'll coordinate with billing to dedup token charges when `reconnect.cause=proxy_pause` and resume_id matches within TTL. Also add a regression check in the billing pipeline.
kevin: Add alert: if `proxy_pause` > 2% of sessions in 10m then page ops. Also add a low-noise alert for billing delta > 0.2%.
ingrid: Runbook note: if spike -> rollback proxy v2 or increase proxy keepalive to 30s temporarily.
sam: Owners: devon(proxy PR), maria(billing/metrics), ingrid(client canary), kevin(alerting/ops), sam(dashboard). I'll file tickets and link.
devon: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/proxy/pull/1234 — header mapping + unit tests + TTL.
maria: Nice. I'll add instrumentation change to the metrics schema and a dashboard panel that surfaces the session sample with `reconnect.cause`.
console-bot: console: rollout flag `sse.linger_canary` created (default: false). Owner: ingrid. Documentation field added to the flag.
kevin: ops-bot can we mute noisy reconnect alerts for the canary window?
ops-bot: ops-bot: muted alert `reconnect-noise` for 6h for canary.
sam: Timeline: get proxy PR merged today, start client canary tonight, monitor 24h, rollback if `proxy_pause` > 2% or billing delta > 0.5%.
ingrid: I'll implement the canary toggle in the SDK and include telemetry opt-in flag.
maria: Also adding a dashboard link in the console rollout UI to show the cause breakdown.
sam: Great work team. :thumbsup: Closing loop once metrics + billing tests pass.
